title: Scalable Test of Genuine Multipartite Entanglement via Partially Randomized Measurements
summary: Certifying genuine multipartite entanglement in quantum systems can require a number of measurements that grows exponentially with the system size. Here we introduce a criterion based on correlation-tensor subsector lengths restricted to local measurement planes and show that it can be evaluated using partially randomized measurements without an explicit exponential dependence on the number of qubits.
